changelog: Investigate (Step 0, Size Integrity Phase 1): the By Exit Reason breakdown's total ($6.60 short of challenge 6's realised P&L) is not a data defect. StatsController::getStats()'s by_exit_reason sums net_pnl (fees already netted per row) but has no trades-level column to hold challenges.funding_adjustment -- funding is deliberately never attributed to a single trade (v3.14.0: overlapping positions and shared funding timestamps make that attribution a guess). The table's total will always sit short of true realised P&L by exactly the funding amount; this is structural, not a bug. Added a UI footnote (exit_reason_excludes_funding) so this doesn't get re-litigated as a discrepancy again

Add: risk_ladder_tiers table (id, challenge_id, lower_balance, upper_balance, risk_pct, active, created_at) -- the risk ladder as data, matching the Strategy Lab convention instead of a hardcoded percentage. Seeded for challenge 6 (Bitfunded Altcoin) with its documented ladder: 0.25% under $9,500, 0.5% $9,500-$10,000, 1.0% above $10,000. Lower-inclusive, upper-exclusive; upper_balance NULL means open-ended

Add: trades.balance_at_entry / planned_risk_pct / actual_risk_pct / risk_deviation_pct / clean_rep (all nullable, no defaults). Backfilled for challenge 6's 59 trades: balance_at_entry from starting_balance + realised P&L of every trade already closed as of this trade's own entry time (handles overlapping trades correctly by construction, not by processing order); planned_risk_pct from the ladder tier for that balance; actual_risk_pct from |entry_price-stop_loss|*lot_size/balance_at_entry -- with a fallback to risk_amount/balance_at_entry when stop_loss is null, since none of challenge 6's 59 rows (all Bitfunded imports) have a recorded stop-loss on file (confirmed, CLAUDE.md v3.14.1) and the literal stop_loss-only formula would leave the whole ladder-adherence/tier-breach feature permanently empty on the one account it exists to describe. Fallback decided explicitly this release, not silently substituted -- carries the same estimated-not-measured caveat r_multiple_source already flags for these rows. clean_rep and the stop_loss-based branch of actual_risk_pct both backfill to their literal spec unmodified and will populate correctly once real pre-entry-journaled trades with real stops close against this or any other ladder-configured challenge

Add: ReviewEngineController v3.6.0 -> v3.7.0. Three new deterministic rule methods (additive -- the existing 20 are unchanged): ruleSizeSkew (losers sized >15% above winners in dollars-per-R, n>=10 resolved trades), ruleTierBreach (>=1 trade exceeded its ladder ceiling by >15%), ruleLadderDrift (<85% of sized trades held the ladder, n>=10 sized trades). Backing metrics (computeSizeIntegrityMetrics): dollars_per_R_winners/losers, size_skew, ladder_adherence_rate, tier_breach_count, worst_deviation, deviation_by_month, current_tier_pct, consecutive_stops_to_failure -- every figure returns the literal string UNAVAILABLE (never a silent zero) when its own denominator is empty

Add: Statistics page Size Integrity panel (dollars-per-R winners vs losers + skew, ladder adherence + tier breaches + worst deviation, deviation-by-month table) -- whole-scope aggregate via the same month/year filter as the rest of the page, not period-scoped like the Review page's version of these metrics

Scope boundary, documented not hidden: this release only backfills challenge 6 and only migrates existing trades. TradeController::saveTrade() and BitfundedImportController::confirm() are NOT touched -- a new trade logged today, or a new import match, will not get balance_at_entry/planned_risk_pct/actual_risk_pct computed going forward. Every metric in this release will stay frozen at its backfilled value for challenge 6 until a follow-up wires the same computation into the save/import paths
